outcome: Archive: the PM reserves the project archive, watches the copy, and checks files the store did not confirm
acceptance_criteria: `/work/4402` against the mock (Next 4990, mock 4991) shows "Archiving in progress. 28 of 42 files copied.", groups with "Copying" rows, and no Tola step card, no "step 3 of 4", no "Ask Tola" — verify: open the page; `frontend/e2e/delivery-archive.spec.ts` asserts those absent.

`/work/4401` shows "Archived and verified: 42 files, each matched in the archive index." and every group "Archived"; the same page with `verified:false` and all files confirmed does not show the sentence — verify: e2e on both mock states; unit test on the status mapper.

Group rows come from `files[].group` as served: a mock with a group the builder did not know ("Legal") draws a "Legal" row with its count; no hard-coded group list exists — verify: unit test; `grep -rn "RFP response" frontend/src/features/delivery-archive` returns nothing outside tests.
The group state words follow part 2: a group with 6 `unknown` and 3 `confirmed` reads "Not confirmed · 6", and the counts across rows equal `files.length` — verify: unit test on the grouping model.
"Handover can start now…" and "Open handover" appear only when `verified` is true; the link appears only when the handover work id is known — verify: e2e with and without it.

`/work/4404` shows the three sources with "RFP response" and "Costing and SOW" checked and "Planning" unchecked; unchecking all disables Start; no source outside `sources[]` can be added — verify: e2e plus component test.

Pressing Start on `/work/4404` sends one `POST /work/4404/archive-files` with `{expected_revision, case_revision, source_ids:[11,12]}`, shows "Queued" (not "Archived") on the 202, and disables the button until the re-read returns — verify: network panel shows one POST; unit test with a mock that counts calls.
With `can_reserve:false` (`/work/4401`) no Start control and no disabled placeholder exist — verify: e2e.
A 409 on Start shows "This changed while you were looking. The page has been refreshed.", re-reads, and sends no second POST — verify: mock scenario `conflict`; count POSTs.

A 422 on Start shows `message` and the first `fields[].message`; a 403 `csrf_failed` refreshes the session once and says "Press Start archive again" with no second POST; a 404 shows "This record is unavailable."; a dropped connection re-reads before any further POST — verify: unit tests with fetch counts.

`/work/4403` shows "The archive store didn't confirm 6 of 42 files…", the RFP group "Not confirmed · 6", and one "Look up" per unknown file; no "Copy again" button exists before a lookup — verify: e2e; assert no element named "Copy again".

"Look up" posts `{revision: <that row's job.revision>, action:"lookup"}` to that row's `job.id`; after the 200 the page re-reads the inventory, and "Copy again" appears only for rows whose re-read `actions[]` contains `retry` — verify: e2e on the 4403 lookup scenario; network panel.
"Copy again" posts `{revision, action:"retry"}` once per press; while any recovery call is in flight all row buttons are disabled — verify: e2e with a slow mock; count POSTs.
A 409 on a recovery refreshes the inventory with no automatic repeat; a recovery that dropped the connection is not repeated until a re-read lists `retry` again — verify: unit tests.

"Check what happened" shows only when `GET /work/{id}` `actions[]` includes `reconcile`; it posts `{expected_revision, action:"reconcile"}` with no outcome or evidence and shows "Checking…" on 202 — verify: e2e on a mock with and without `reconcile`; request body assertion.

No part of the page offers "mark found" or "mark not found", and no archive screen text promises "no approval step", "keep, never purge" or "nothing was purged" — verify: `grep -rniE "mark (each|found)|never purge|no approval" frontend/src/features/delivery-archive` returns nothing; e2e text check.

A null `job` (not started) draws the group as "Not started" and no buttons; a null `receipt` shows no receipt time; a null `store` draws no store line; `limited:true` shows "Copy limit reached" — verify: unit test on the mappers.
Unknown is not zero: a null `revision`/`case_revision` (`/work/4407`) is not sent as 0 and Start stays disabled — verify: unit test on the token mapper; e2e.

Polling: re-reads every 5 s while any file is `pending` or `leased` or work `state` is `processing`; one read when idle; paused in a hidden tab; a failed poll keeps the last read and shows "couldn't refresh"; 401/403/404 on a poll replaces the page and stops polling — verify: unit test with fake timers; network panel count on `/work/4402` and `/work/4401`.

Another user's work item (`/work/4405`) and a live id the account cannot see both show exactly "This record is unavailable." — verify: open both; unit test on the 404 body. A person without write rights (`can_reserve:false`, no `reconcile`) sees the index but no write control — verify: e2e.
`/work/4406` shows "2 files are on hold." and "Copy limit reached", with no buttons on the held rows — verify: e2e.

Against live Django (8030, account with PM scope) on a real archive work item, the page's group counts, file count, `verified` word and store line equal `GET /api/v1/work/{id}/archive-files` — verify: compare the page with `oa.py live GET /api/v1/work/{work_id}/archive-files 3` shape and the `curl` JSON with the session.
The code imports live types from `live-schema.d.ts` and not the v7 `@/api/schema` for this page — verify: `grep -rn "api/schema'" frontend/src/features/delivery-archive` returns nothing.

`archiveAdapter.ts` registers with F-85's `registerLineAdapter`, `sections()` returns existing `Section` objects the `Sections` renderer draws, and `commands()` returns the four descriptors whose `body()` includes the action, the tokens and no key field; a null token stays null — verify: `archiveAdapter.test.ts`; typecheck.

Viewport check at 1440 and 390: the page matches the SCR-47 default, working and uncertain boards for the parts that remain (header, status sentence, archive index with group, files, state, the Next block); parts removed leave no empty gap or empty heading — verify: screenshots at both widths against `design/screens.md` SCR-47 artboards.
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` pass, and the live-schema drift test still passes — verify: `delivery/checks.sh` result.

New tests cover: the grouping and counts model, the status sentence, token mapping with nulls, each write's single-POST rule, and the 409/422/403/404/429/503 mapping — verify: test files named in the build report.

risk.rationale: Medium. The screen reserves an archive and can retry file copies. That is a cross-layer contract with revision tokens and an uncertain-effect recovery path, but it moves no money, identity or client messages. Retry is gated by a prior lookup and by the API's `actions[]`. Surfaces: ui, api, and product-decision (the design's "no approval step" and "mark found or not found" change to a person reserving and a system lookup, which is PSL's decision per D-185). Product acceptance is required because the flow and copy differ from the board. Retries must reconcile before repeating. Never invent attempt counts, file counts or limits.
